snippet.title: Night Guard - The Last Shift (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Night Guard - The Last Shift is a retro horror game about one very bad night on the job.

Watch the parking lot, follow orders, deal with strange visitors, and try to make it through the shift.

Wishlist Night Guard - The Last Shift on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4635890/Night_Guard__The_Last_Shift/
